item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 10/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will bring humid and misty weather to the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. It will be rather warm during the day. Meanwhile, showers associated with upper-air disturbances will affect inland Guangdong. A trough of low pressure will form over central China tomorrow and develop into a cold front. The cold front is expected to move across Guangdong on Saturday. The associated showers and squally thunderstorms will affect the region. Under the influence of a dry continental airstream, showers will ease off over Guangdong early next week. The weather will improve and it will be slightly cooler in the morning.
